notes.title: Notice Regarding the Next Update
notes.content: [p]Thank you for your continued support.[/p][p][/p][p][strike]The preparations for the next update are complete. However, due to Steam’s security protocols, the release on the official branch (default) may be delayed by up to [b]72 hours.[/b][/strike][/p][p][/p][p][strike]During this period, you can try the new version early via the beta branch.[/strike][/p][p][strike]To join the beta branch, go to your Library → Right-click the game → Properties → “Betas” tab, and select “[b]public_beta[/b].”For details on the update, please see the [b]“Update History”[/b] section in the Community Hub.[/strike][/p][p][/p][p][strike]We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your patience until the update is fully released.[/strike][/p][p][/p][p]The update has been applied to the official release, so you can now play from the official version.[/p][p]Thank you for continuing to support [b]“Clean Freak! Perfect Cook!”[/b][/p]

notes.title: Bug & Issue Reporting
notes.content:
[p]Thank you very much for playing "Clean Freak! Perfect Cook!"[/p][p]If you encounter any bugs or issues while playing, please report them using the methods below.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]■ What to include in your report[/b][/p][list][*][p]The situation where the issue occurred (what actions you took)[/p][/*][*][p]Where it happened (stage, mode, etc.)[/p][/*][*][p]Your environment (OS, whether you used a controller, etc.)[/p][/*][*][p]Screenshots or videos if possible[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]■ How to report[/b][/p][list][*][p]Post in the Steam Community Hub threads[/p][/*][/list][p]or[/p][list][*][p]Send an email to:
snaketone.info@gmail.com[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]We greatly appreciate your continued support for "Clean Freak! Perfect Cook!".[/p]
